description: WinAurex Windows 10/11 Service Classification Matrix and Protection Catalog

services.Name: RpcSs
services.EstImpact: Critical Core System Subsystem - Disabling causes immediate unbootable system (BSOD).
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Unbootable system, BSOD during boot, fatal IPC failure.

services.Name: RpcEptMapper
services.EstImpact: Critical Core RPC Subsystem - Resolves RPC interfaces to endpoints.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: RPC communication failure, system services crash.

services.Name: DcomLaunch
services.EstImpact: Launches DCOM servers. Essential for system startup.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: System hang on startup, core components fail to launch.

services.Name: lsass
services.EstImpact: Core Windows security authentication and policy enforcement.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Logon failure, complete system security crash.

services.Name: lsaiso
services.EstImpact: Virtualization-based security for credential protection.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Credential Guard failure, domain authentication drop.

services.Name: SamSs
services.EstImpact: Manages local security accounts and user credentials.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Logon failure, inability to authenticate users.

services.Name: KeyIso
services.EstImpact: Hosts cryptographic keys in isolated process for security.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: BitLocker, Windows Hello, and EFS key access failure.

services.Name: VaultSvc
services.EstImpact: Provides secure storage and retrieval of credentials.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Saved network and application passwords fail to resolve.

services.Name: CryptSvc
services.EstImpact: Confirms signatures of Windows files and manages root certificates.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Driver signature verification fails, Windows Update fails, device installation breaks.

services.Name: WinDefend
services.EstImpact: Real-time antimalware, behavioral monitoring, and AMSI memory inspection.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Severe security compromise, zero protection against malware.

services.Name: mpssvc
services.EstImpact: Host firewall and network packet filtering platform.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Breaks network isolation, breaks UWP application networking.

services.Name: mpsdrv
services.EstImpact: Kernel driver authorization for Windows Firewall filtering.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Network firewall rules fail to attach to kernel driver.

services.Name: BFE
services.EstImpact: Core security platform managing firewall and IPsec policies.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Complete network disconnection, firewall services fail to start.

services.Name: wuauserv
services.EstImpact: Detects, downloads, and installs cumulative security updates.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Blocks critical security vulnerability fixes and hotfixes.

services.Name: TrustedInstaller
services.EstImpact: Component-Based Servicing (CBS) installer for Windows components.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: DISM component repair fails, Windows feature installation fails.

services.Name: UsoSvc
services.EstImpact: Orchestrates scanning, downloading, and installing Windows updates.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Windows update delivery and driver sync break.

services.Name: WaaSMedicSvc
services.EstImpact: Repairs Windows Update servicing components.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Loss of self-healing for servicing stack.

services.Name: msiserver
services.EstImpact: Engine for MSI installations and software servicing.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Standard MSI installations fail with error 1719.

services.Name: Appinfo
services.EstImpact: Facilitates UAC elevation prompt execution for administrative tasks.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Administrative elevation fails; 'Run as administrator' crashes.

services.Name: AppXSvc
services.EstImpact: Provides infrastructure support for deploying Store and Modern applications.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: AppX and MSIX installation and registration fail.

services.Name: StateRepository
services.EstImpact: Provides modern AppX indexing and application lifecycle state.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Start Menu, Taskbar, and modern apps freeze or crash completely.

services.Name: ClipSVC
services.EstImpact: Provides infrastructure support for the Microsoft Store client licensing.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Store applications fail to launch with licensing error.

services.Name: InstallService
services.EstImpact: Enables installation and update of Store apps.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Inability to install or update modern Windows apps.

services.Name: Netlogon
services.EstImpact: Maintains secure channel between computer and domain controller.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Domain authentication and domain logon fail.

services.Name: Dhcp
services.EstImpact: Registers and updates IP addresses and DNS records.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Total loss of network and internet connectivity.

services.Name: Dnscache
services.EstImpact: Caches Domain Name System (DNS) names.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Hostname resolution fails; web browsing and cloud apps cannot connect.

services.Name: nsi
services.EstImpact: Delivers network notifications to client services.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Network adapters cannot report link status; network stack malfunctions.

services.Name: NlaSvc
services.EstImpact: Collects and stores configuration information for the network.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Network category identification fails, false 'No Internet' state.

services.Name: netprofm
services.EstImpact: Identifies networks and notifies apps of network changes.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Network flyout and connection status identification fail.

services.Name: LanmanWorkstation
services.EstImpact: Creates and maintains client network connections to remote servers.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Cannot connect to SMB shares, NAS devices, or network printers.

services.Name: LanmanServer
services.EstImpact: Supports file, print, and named-pipe sharing over network.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Local machine cannot share files or printers to the LAN.

services.Name: WlanSvc
services.EstImpact: Configures and manages wireless network adapters.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: All Wi-Fi interfaces and wireless connections become completely unavailable.

services.Name: Audiosrv
services.EstImpact: Manages system audio playback and recording devices.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Total loss of system audio.

services.Name: AudioEndpointBuilder
services.EstImpact: Enumerates and initializes audio endpoints and DACs.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Audio hardware is not detected.

services.Name: PlugPlay
services.EstImpact: Enables the computer to recognize and adapt to hardware changes.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Hardware devices, USBs, and GPUs fail to initialize.

services.Name: EventLog
services.EstImpact: Manages events and event logs for security and diagnostics.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: System event auditing, troubleshooting, and crash diagnostics disabled.

services.Name: TermService
services.EstImpact: Allows users to connect interactively to remote computer.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Remote Desktop connections and multi-session user switching fail.

services.Name: ProfSvc
services.EstImpact: Loads and unloads user profiles during logon.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: User Profile Service failed the logon; permanent lockout.

services.Name: UserManager
services.EstImpact: Provides user management components for multi-user session management.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Multi-user sessions and modern shell isolation crash.

services.Name: Schedule
services.EstImpact: Enables automated task scheduling across the operating system.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: System maintenance, background servicing, and scheduled jobs fail.

services.Name: Power
services.EstImpact: Manages power policy and power policy notification delivery.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Power management, sleep/wake transitions, and thermal control fail.

services.Name: Themes
services.EstImpact: Provides user experience theme management.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Desktop UI visual failure, DWM window styling glitches.

services.Name: Winmgmt
services.EstImpact: Provides standard interface for system management information.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: WMI and CIM queries fail; administrative tools crash.

services.Name: FontCache
services.EstImpact: Optimizes performance of applications by caching commonly used font data.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Severe text rendering latency across system applications.

services.Name: FontCache3.0.0.0
services.EstImpact: Optimizes performance of WPF applications by caching font glyphs.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: WPF GUI dashboards and .NET apps crash or experience font lag.

services.Name: BDESVC
services.EstImpact: Provides full volume drive encryption.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Encrypted drive unlock and recovery password validation fail.

services.Name: gpsvc
services.EstImpact: Enforces settings configured by administrators via Group Policy.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Group policy enforcement fails system-wide.

services.Name: BrokerInfrastructure
services.EstImpact: Controls background task execution for modern UWP apps.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Modern application background notifications fail.

services.Name: CoreMessagingRegistrar
services.EstImpact: Manages communication between core OS components.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Modern Windows shell components fail to exchange messages.

services.Name: DeviceInstall
services.EstImpact: Enables device driver installation for newly plugged devices.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: New hardware, USB peripherals, and GPU updates fail to install.

services.Name: DevQueryBroker
services.EstImpact: Enables apps to discover and query devices in background.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Modern device discovery APIs break.

services.Name: bthserv
services.EstImpact: Supports discovery and association of remote Bluetooth devices.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Bluetooth audio, controllers, mice, and keyboards fail.

services.Name: bthport
services.EstImpact: Kernel driver support for Bluetooth hardware.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Bluetooth hardware interface drops.

services.Name: bluetoothuserservice
services.EstImpact: Provides user-session Bluetooth service isolation.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: User session Bluetooth pairing fails.

services.Name: comsysapp
services.EstImpact: Manages the configuration and tracking of COM+ components.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: COM+ applications crash on launch.

services.Name: msdtc
services.EstImpact: Coordinates transactions spanning multiple resource managers.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Enterprise database and transaction services fail.

services.Name: ktmrm
services.EstImpact: Coordinates transactions between MSDTC and Kernel Transaction Manager.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Transactional NTFS and transaction coordination fail.

services.Name: bits
services.EstImpact: Transfers files in the background using idle network bandwidth.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Windows Update, Store downloads, and winget background downloads break.

services.Name: SecurityHealthService
services.EstImpact: Maintains Windows Security center state and notifications.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Windows Security notification center and security dashboard fail.

services.Name: nvsvc
services.EstImpact: Critical NVIDIA GPU hardware driver support service.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: GPU driver crashing, G-Sync failure, display stutter.

services.Name: amdfendrs
services.EstImpact: Critical AMD GPU display recovery and driver stability service.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: AMD GPU driver crash recovery disabled.

services.Name: amdppkgsvc
services.EstImpact: Critical AMD CPU power management and provisioning.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: AMD CPU boost clock profiles fail to configure.

services.Name: amdpmfservice
services.EstImpact: AMD Platform Management Framework for modern Ryzen processors.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Ryzen processor thermal and power management fail.

services.Name: igfxCUIService2.0.0.0
services.DisplayName: Intel HD Graphics Control Panel Service
services.EstImpact: Intel Graphics display and resolution configuration daemon.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Intel GPU display panel fails to initialize.

services.Name: vmtoolsd
services.EstImpact: VMware virtual machine guest synchronization daemon.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Loss of mouse integration, clipboard sync, and resolution autoscaling in VM.

services.Name: vmicguestinterface
services.EstImpact: Hyper-V guest integration service.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Hyper-V guest management communication fails.

services.Name: DiagTrack
services.EstImpact: Saves ~20-30 MB RAM, eliminates background ETW telemetry upload.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None. Disables Microsoft usage data collection.

services.Name: dmwappushservice
services.DisplayName: Device Management Wireless Application Protocol (WAP) Push routing service
services.EstImpact: Suppresses WAP telemetry routing and background threads.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: WerSvc
services.EstImpact: Prevents crash dump generation and transmission to Microsoft.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None. Stops error reporting prompts.

services.Name: PcaSvc
services.EstImpact: Eliminates process launch compatibility hooks and memory overhead.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None. Obsolete compatibility prompts suppressed.

services.Name: MapsBroker
services.EstImpact: Saves ~10 MB RAM, eliminates map tile background sync.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None (Offline maps will not update in the background).

services.Name: lfsvc
services.EstImpact: Prevents continuous location polling and telemetry tracking.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Apps will not have automatic location detection.

services.Name: RetailDemo
services.EstImpact: Eliminates retail store demonstration background loops.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: wisvc
services.EstImpact: Halts Windows Insider preview telemetry ingestion and ring sync.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: DusmSvc
services.EstImpact: Stops background tracking of per-app network byte consumption.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Network usage statistics page will not track per-app usage.

services.Name: RemoteRegistry
services.EstImpact: Hardens system security by preventing remote registry edits.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: Fax
services.EstImpact: Disables legacy dial-up fax transmission infrastructure.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: SharedAccess
services.EstImpact: Halts NAT packet routing daemon if not acting as Wi-Fi hotspot.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Mobile hotspot feature will be disabled.

services.Name: AJRouter
services.EstImpact: Disables message routing for AllJoyn IoT devices.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: WMPNetworkSvc
services.DisplayName: Windows Media Player Network Sharing Service
services.EstImpact: Stops UPnP/DLNA media library broadcasting across local subnet. Saves ~12 MB RAM.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: NaturalAuthentication
services.EstImpact: Disables unused proximity and companion device biometric unlock helpers.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: SensorService
services.EstImpact: Disables orientation and ambient light sensor polling on desktop PCs.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Auto-rotation disabled on convertibles.

services.Name: SensrSvc
services.EstImpact: Disables sensor hardware monitoring daemons on desktop hardware.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: SensorDataService
services.EstImpact: Disables sensor data logging for desktop hardware.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: MixedReality
services.EstImpact: Disables background scanning for Windows Mixed Reality VR headsets.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Mixed reality headsets require manual re-enable.

services.Name: HoloSvc
services.EstImpact: Disables holographic spatial perception runtime on non-VR workstations.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: None.

services.Name: XblAuthManager
services.EstImpact: Suppresses Xbox Live authentication daemons for non-Xbox users.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Xbox Live sign-in in games will require manual re-enablement.

services.Name: XblGameSave
services.EstImpact: Eliminates background cloud save sync for Microsoft Store games.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Xbox cloud saves disabled.

services.Name: XboxNetApiSvc
services.EstImpact: Disables Xbox peer-to-peer network helpers.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Xbox multiplayer voice chat disabled.

services.Name: XboxGipSvc
services.EstImpact: Disables Xbox wireless adapter pairing daemon if using third-party controllers or wired USB.
services.CriticalFailureRisk: Xbox wireless proprietary adapter pairing disabled.
